entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Linda. How can I help you today?
Hi Linda. I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's David Miller, and the email is d.miller@example.com.
Thank you, David. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand, delivered about two weeks ago.
That's the one. I'd like to send it back for a refund.
No problem at all. I see here that you're well within the 90 days for a full refund, so we can definitely get that processed for you.

Absolutely. And I see you're a VIP member, thank you for your loyalty. As a little bonus, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. I'm generating your prepaid return label right now. You should receive it in your email inbox in the next few minutes.
Wow, thank you so much, Linda. I really appreciate that.

You are very welcome, David. Just print that return label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks again for your help!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
